headline: Paste your website. See a better one — free.
subhead: We audit your current site and build a preview of your new one. Like it? Publish online for one fixed price. No calls, ever.
taxNote: Prices in Canadian dollars, plus applicable tax.

steps.title: Paste your link
steps.text: Add your website (or skip if you do not have one yet). We use your real business info.

steps.title: Get audit + preview
steps.text: Automatic check of your site, then a link to a labelled preview of your new page — by email.

steps.title: Publish if you want
steps.text: Pay the fixed price online, we put it live and email domain steps. You own everything.

plans.name: Audit + preview
plans.text: See your new site before you pay. No card required.

plans.name: Publish
plans.text: Take your approved preview live. Domain setup instructions by email.

plans.name: Care
plans.text: Optional hosting, updates and changes by email. Cancel anytime.

checkoutNote: Stripe Checkout is wired on the preview page when you are ready to pay. Until then, we email you the payment link with your preview.
changesRule: The price on this page is the price. Extra work is quoted by email before it is done.

faq.a: No. Everything is on this site, by email, or an AI chat that identifies itself as AI. We do not book calls.
Yes. The site, domain and content are yours. You can export and leave anytime.
We publish your approved preview, email DNS and domain steps, and send receipts. Ongoing questions go by email.

faq.q: Is the preview my real site?
faq.a: No. Previews are clearly labelled until you publish. Nothing pretends to be live without your yes.
